title: Economist
summary: ECON'OMIST, noun One who manages domestic or other concerns with frugality; one who expends money, time or labor judiciously, and without waste. 1. One who writes on economy; the writer of a treatise

inlines.v: ECON'OMIST, noun One who manages domestic or other concerns with frugality; one who expends money, time or labor judiciously, and without waste. 1. One who writes on economy; the writer of a treatise on economy.
